name: history is the data
headline: History *is* the work
say: Every change you make becomes a new layer: a complete record of that place at that moment. Nothing is overwritten. The history of a place is a numbered list, and the newest entry is how it looks now. Undo is simply reading an earlier step. You can rewind a page, restore any moment, or save a snapshot before you try something bold. It works like version control, for everything you make, not only for code.
